scripts.build: npm run build -w @killerdraw/core && npm run build -w @killerdraw/app
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/app
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.icon: node scripts/make-icon.mjs && cd packages/desktop && npx tauri icon ../../docs/icon.png && cp ../../docs/icon.png ../app/public/favicon.png
